name: Princeton Plaza
summary: Princeton Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in San Pablo, California, offering convenient access to local retail and services. With a 4.2-star rating and nearly 1,000 reviews, it serves as a reliable community retail destination.
demographics: Princeton Plaza serves a diverse, working-class community in San Pablo and the greater Contra Costa County area. The primary trade area consists of middle-income families and households seeking convenient, value-oriented shopping options close to home. Typical visitors include local residents running everyday errands, with a demographic mix reflecting the broader San Pablo community's ethnic diversity and family-oriented household composition. The center attracts practical, convenience-focused shoppers who prioritize accessibility and everyday necessities over luxury or experiential retail.
description: Princeton Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located on San Pablo Dam Road in San Pablo, California. This convenient retail destination serves the local community with a practical mix of everyday services and businesses. The center maintains strong community ties with a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,000 customer reviews, reflecting its consistent service to area residents. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Princeton Plaza provides accessible shopping hours for working families and busy professionals. Managed by JNM Commercial, the plaza continues to be a reliable retail hub for San Pablo residents seeking convenient access to neighborhood goods and services.
